key_insight: Mac-Diff is a conditional diffusion model that uses locality-aware cross-modal attention to generate diverse, realistic conformational ensembles for unseen proteins, capturing both dynamic flexibility and structural heterogeneity in a single generative framework.
problem_solved: Existing generative models for protein structure often produce single static predictions or fail to capture the full diversity of conformational states; this paper addresses the challenge of generating diverse, biologically plausible ensembles for proteins not seen during training.
method: Conditional diffusion generative backbone that produces protein conformations conditioned on input protein features (e.g., sequence or initial structure).

Locality-aware cross-modal attention module aligns information from multiple modalities (sequence, structural priors, experimental constraints) while emphasizing local interactions critical for realistic conformations.
Sampling and training objectives designed to encourage ensemble diversity and structural heterogeneity so the model outputs multiple distinct, plausible conformers for unseen proteins.
impact: Mac-Diff enables AI/ML practitioners to move beyond single-structure prediction toward principled ensemble generation, improving modeling of protein dynamics and uncertainty for downstream tasks like drug design and functional inference.
visual_elements: Model architecture diagram highlighting the conditional diffusion pipeline and the locality-aware cross-modal attention block.
Overlayed ensemble visualization: multiple semi-transparent protein structures showing generated conformational diversity for one sequence.
Attention heatmap illustrating locality-aware alignment between sequence positions and structural coordinates.
Bar/line chart comparing diversity and accuracy metrics (e.g., ensemble RMSD, coverage) versus baseline methods.
paper_title: Conditional diffusion with locality-aware modal alignment for generating diverse protein conformational ensembles
paper_authors: Baoli Wang, Chenglin Wang, Jingyang Chen, Danlin Liu, Changzhi Sun
